• Designed and ran a study of gauge-equivariant neural preconditioners for solving the Dirac equation in lattice QCD; evaluated different model architectures and loss functions with the goal of reducing iterations to convergence on conjugate gradient.
  • Delivered a model that cut solver iterations roughly 2x below the state-of-the-art method while reducing its per-system setup cost.
  • Proposed three novel architectures and diagnosed why they failed to improve results, tracing the outcome to specific structural properties and narrowing where future gains are likely to be found.
  • First-authored the resulting paper with collaborators at MIT and Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory; presented findings in a poster and a paper (soon to be submitted to a workshop).

• Conducted research with Professor Alvin Jin in the field of topological deep learning.
  • Analyzed changes in topological invariants (Betti numbers) across network layers and their effect on inversion ability in predictive coding networks, a type of invertible neural network.
  • Developed extensive Python codebase implementing predictive coding networks in JAX and topological analysis using Ripser and NumPy/Scikit-learn.
  • Had paper (first-author) accepted to the 2026 Topology, Algebra, and Geometry in Data Science (TAG-DS) conference (also accepted as a lightning talk), the ICML 2026 Workshop on Weight-Space Symmetries, and presented a poster at the Conference on Topological Data Analysis at the University of Missouri.

• Joined the Workspace AI Platform team, which integrates Gemini into products such as Google Docs, Slides, and Gmail.
  • Designed and built an access control system for custom Gems (personalized Gemini instances), streamlining creation and secure sharing across Google Workspace teams.
  • Implemented role-based permissions in C++ using Google's internal server framework, managing authorization and routing for millions of potential users.
  • Developed Python automation script to manage enum ID generation and updates across a 10,000+ line shared codebase, eliminating merge conflicts and synchronization errors for a multi-engineer team.
  • Wrote extensive documentation on my work to ensure correct use and easier navigation in the future; created technical diagrams and professional slideshow to present my work at the end of the summer.

• Leveraged Nunjucks to create modular HTML templates and incorporated jQuery to add dynamic functionality and interactivity to web pages.
  • Optimized UTM parameters to more effectively identify users and dynamically alter the product accordingly.
  • Used KanPlan agile framework built into Jira to more efficiently plan, test, and integrate features, as well as identify and squash bugs.
  • Worked in a modern software development environment, creating unique Git branches for each issue and submitting GitHub pull requests for senior developer approval and merging into the final product.
  • Utilized Node.js and npm scripts to test and execute code, ensuring quality and functionality before submission for approval.
